messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 401s against /v1/auth (svc-auth-proxy). 1200 failures in 8m, unusual X-Forwarded-For distribution. Possible credential stuffing or leaked token stream. Paging on-call: @emma_oncall

emma_oncall: I’m on it. pulling logs now, can someone mute noisy downstream alerts? :wave:

raj_sre: muting alert group for /v1/auth err5xx alert (5m). keeping rate monitors on. any customer-facing symptoms?

morgan_pd: seen a small uptick in error rate for webhooks (0.8% -> 3%). CS flagged two customers seeing 401s on background jobs. no PII exfil reports yet.

lia_sec: lia_sec joining. we should treat as potential token leak until proven otherwise. immediate steps: 1) block offending IP ranges 2) rotate prone service tokens 3) enable short-term stricter rate limits 4) start collection of sample request headers for forensics.

emma_oncall: reproducing sample from logs: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer r_abc123..." https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth` — many requests have header `X-Client-Id: unknown-client` and `User-Agent: python-requests/2.28`

raj_sre: deploying quick WAF rule to block top 20 IPs by request volume. will also add a rate-limit rule for anonymous clients.

ops-rotations: ops-rotations: initiating emergency rotation for service token `svc-webhook-prod`. ETA ~12m. will publish rotated keys to vault+audit log.

lia_sec: Legal/Privacy notified (cc: security@). Lia, can you confirm scope: logs, tokens, any s3 exposures?

lia_sec: quick scoop: logs are in standard pipeline; no public S3 buckets identified in initial scan. we do see several requests with tokens that appear valid but used from many IPs. treat as credential stuffing or token scraping. recommend broad rotation for tokens issued in last 48h with unusual usage.

emma_oncall: Emily (emma_oncall) to raj: can you add a short-lived denial rule for requests lacking `X-Client-Id`? that would mitigate bot traffic without impacting known integrators.

raj_sre: yes adding rule: `if missing X-Client-Id then 429 after 10r/min`. rolling now to edge :rocket:

morgan_pd: coordinating CS messaging. draft: "We're investigating increased authentication failures for some integrations; we've applied mitigations and rotated suspected tokens. If your integrations show failures, please contact support." want to hold until rotation done.

lia_sec: start a narrow key rotation sweep: rotate service tokens for affected services and issue short TTL tokens for customer-facing SDKs. Ops-rotations confirm when `svc-webhook-prod` done.

ops-rotations: `svc-webhook-prod` rotated and pushed to vault at 1829473058. audit entries created. will push new creds to deploys in 5m.

emma_oncall: saw immediate drop in 401 spike after WAF + rotation. 401s per minute down from 200 -> 6. continuing watch.

lia_sec: collect suspect token samples for threat intel (store in secure evidence bucket). lia_sec: uploading sanitized headers at 1829473201.

raj_sre: will keep edge rules for 2h, then evaluate. opened a follow-up Jira: AUTH-INC-472 with investigative tasks and telemetry dashboards.

morgan_pd: prepped customer message, legal said OK for advisory; hold for final impact tally.

emma_oncall: summary for bridge: mitigation applied (WAF rule + rate limits), rotated `svc-webhook-prod` and flagged tokens; impact limited to ~2-3 customers transient 401s, no confirmed data exfil. continuing 4h post-incident monitoring. handing off to on-call rotation for follow-up: @raj_sre.

raj_sre: taking post-incident ownership. will coordinate root cause, scope tokens to revoke, and recommend long-term mitigations (client identity enforcement + token anomaly detection).

lia_sec: filing security incident report draft; will add timeline and evidence links. tagging sec-incident channel after draft review.

morgan_pd: thanks team. CS: standby for outbound advisory at 1830000000 if no new issues. :white_check_mark:

emma_oncall: ending active bridge; keep thread updated for any regressions. :lock:
